'''Rein Ratas''' (9 May 1938 – 18 April 2022) was an Estonian politician, representing the [[Estonian Centre Party]]. Ratas served in the [[Riigikogu]] from 2007 to 2011 and again from 2015 to 2018. Due to a lengthy illness, Ratas was substituted by [[Igor Kravtšenko]] from December 2016 until September 2018, when Ratas formally left his seat for Kravtšenko.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://news.err.ee/861593/father-of-prime-minister-stands-down-from-parliament |title=Father of prime minister stands down from parliament |publisher=ERR |date=15 September 2018 |accessdate=15 September 2018}}</ref>

Ratas is the father of former Estonian Prime Minister [[Jüri Ratas]].

Ratas died on 18 April 2022, aged 83.<ref>{{Cite news |date=18 April 2022 |title=Suri poliitik ja bioloog Rein Ratas |url=https://www.err.ee/1608568666/suri-poliitik-ja-bioloog-rein-ratas |access-date=23 February 2026 |work=ERR |language=et}}</ref>
